zh.title: 達美航空波音737 MAX 10將配備24個頭等艙座位
zh.summary: 達美航空調整波音737 MAX 10客機佈局；頭等艙座位數由20席增至24席
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，達美航空將在其引進的波音 737 MAX 10 客機上配置 24 個頭等艙座位。此項規劃顯示該航空公司正調整其波音 737 MAX 10 機隊的客艙佈局設計。
本次確定的 24 席頭等艙座位安排，相較於達美航空最初設定的 20 席頭等艙座位規劃有所增加。該項數量變更反映了其客艙座位的最新調整。
達美航空針對波音 737 MAX 10 客機的最新座位規劃，將頭等艙座位總數由原先預計的 20 席增加至 24 席，確立了該機型未來的頭等艙配置。

en.title: Delta Air Lines to Feature 24 First Class Seats on Boeing 737 MAX 10 Fleet
en.summary: Delta Air Lines expands Boeing 737 MAX 10 premium cabin seating, increasing First Class to 24 seats.
body: Delta Air Lines plans to feature 24 First Class seats on its upcoming fleet of Boeing 737 MAX 10 aircraft. Information reported by Simple Flying indicates that the airline is expanding the premium seat capacity within the passenger cabin layout for this aircraft type.

The revised cabin arrangement specifying 24 First Class seats represents a notable increase from the initial plan, which was based on a 20-seat First Class configuration. Delta Air Lines has updated its seat count layout for the Boeing 737 MAX 10 accordingly.
This configuration update establishes a higher number of First Class seats for Delta Air Lines' Boeing 737 MAX 10 operations compared to the previously targeted 20-seat specification.
